Indusind Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proposed placement of equity shares of Rs. 10 each ("Equity Shares") of lnduslnd Bank Limited (the "Company") with Qualified Institutions Buyers ("QIBs") under Chapter VIII of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2009 by the Company , pursuant to a Qualified Institutions Placement by the Company ("Issue").

Prime Securities Limited has informed the Exchange vide letter dated June 30, 2015 regarding Update on developments in matters regarding Prime Broking Company (india) Limited a 100% Subsidiary Company.

Time Technoplast Limited has submitted to exchange a copy of Corporate Announcement being released on sale of its equity in 50:50 JV in South China & Purchase of balance 50% equity in 50:50 JV in Egypt.
